Julie (CSM): Heads-up — SentraAI renewal in ~45 days. Onboarding usage spike + embeddings heavy. Need a tight spend forecast and recommended guardrails. Can we get a 30/60-day burn forecast and suggested thresholds? tagging @Omar @Ella @Raj @Pete
Omar (FinOps): On it. Current 30d burn = ~48k tokens/day, embeddings ~62% of cost. If trend continues est remaining term = ~$68k. I'll run a forecast and set alerts.
Omar (FinOps): SQL I ran to pull daily usage for the last 60 days:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as d, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'sentraai' AND ts > now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d;
```
Raj (Solutions): For embeddings-heavy flows we can switch to embed-lite + caching. Ballpark savings 30-45% with small latency tradeoff.
Julie (CSM): Nice. Can you quantify savings with current batch sizes? Need numbers for the QBR deck.
Raj (Solutions): Quick calc: if we reduce embed model cost by 40% -> monthly savings ~ $14k. If we add prefix caching -> additional ~12% (very rough).
Ella (Onboarding): FYI we still have 8 teams in active ramp. Two large teams doing heavy experimentation this week (prod-sim runs). Might keep burn elevated short-term.
BudgetBot: Alert: sentraai usage crossed 80% of committed credits for the month — auto-note to channel. https://redwood.internal/alerts/4821
Omar (FinOps): Received BudgetBot — I'll set alerts at 75% and 90% and prepare a variance chart + 30/60/90 forecast slide by EOD.
Pete (Product): Please capture any product asks during QBR — one request we've seen: ability to toggle experimental runs at the org level (quick kill switch). @Julie can you confirm exact wording in the meeting?
Julie (CSM): Will capture and add to the feedback doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/sentraai-feedback — adding a section for enablement notes and feature asks.
Julie (CSM): Proposed immediate actions:
1) Run a precise savings calc for embed-lite + caching (Raj)
2) Set threshold alerts + produce forecast slide (Omar)
3) Schedule a cost-focused enablement workshop next Tue (Ella)
4) Capture feature asks and customer impact statements (Julie)
Ella (Onboarding): Tue works. Draft agenda: cost-saving patterns, caching best-practices, batching knobs, how to throttle experimental runs. I'll invite the 8 ramp teams.
Raj (Solutions): I'll drop a suggested config for cached embeddings + batching to test on a sandbox:
```
model: embed-lite-10k
batching:
  max_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 64
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_hours: 12
```
Julie (CSM): Thanks — I'll put Raj's config and Omar's charts into the deck. Can everyone review slides in #customer-success tomorrow 9am PT?
Omar (FinOps): 9am PT works for me. I'll bring the variance chart and commit vs actual.
BudgetBot: Note: next auto-invoice scheduled in 7 days for sentraai (committed credits).
Julie (CSM): Great — will upload draft slides to the shared QBR folder and ping the group when ready. :thumbsup:
